newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Jan/March cocoa imports up at 84,725 T.
newsitem.headline: German Jan/March cocoa imports up at 84,725 T.

text.p: German cocoa bean imports from third countries in January/March 1997 totalled 84,725 tonnes after 69,593 tonnes in the same 1996 period, federal statistics office data showed.

Jan/Feb data had lagged those of last year but the figure for the three months was boosted by a high March import tonnage of 47,048 tonnes, which exceeded last year's March figure of 26,270 and the 22,414 tonnes received in February 1997.
The data did not include volumes received via other European Union countries.
Leading supplier Ivory Coast shipped a total 36,965 tonnes in March, followed by Ghana's 4,607, Indonesia's 2,394 and Nigeria's 1,153.
March import value (third countries only) was 105.47 million marks versus 59.08 million a year earlier.
